messages.content: What year did Aunt May first appear?
Aunt May first appeared alongside Peter Parker and Spider-Man in Amazing Fantasy #15.
Who is Miles Morales?
Miles Morales is another major Spider-Man who originated in an alternate universe and later became part of the main Marvel continuity.
Give me a concise explanation of Spider-Man: Homecoming about.
Spider-Man: Homecoming stars Tom Holland and follows Peter Parker balancing high school with superhero responsibilities under the broader MCU setting.
Is Kingpin a Spider-Man villain?
Yes. Wilson Fisk, the Kingpin, is a major crime boss who has repeatedly opposed Spider-Man and other New York heroes.
Give me a concise explanation of Peter Parker's relationship with MJ.
Peter Parker and Mary Jane Watson have one of Spider-Man's most important long-running relationships; they have been friends, romantic partners, and spouses in different continuity states.
When did Liz Allan first appear?
Liz Allan was introduced in Amazing Fantasy #15 as part of Peter Parker's high-school world.
How strong is Spider-Man — explain briefly.
Spider-Man possesses superhuman physical strength that is substantially beyond a normal human's capabilities.
What happened after Spider-Man's debut?
After his debut in Amazing Fantasy #15, Spider-Man received his own ongoing series, The Amazing Spider-Man, beginning in 1963.
Who is the main Spider-Man in Marvel's Spider-Man?
Marvel's Spider-Man presents an experienced Peter Parker as its main playable Spider-Man.
Tell me about Spider-Man.
Spider-Man is the superhero identity primarily associated with Peter Parker, although many other characters have carried the mantle.
Why was Spider-Man different from many earlier superheroes?
Spider-Man was presented as a teenager dealing with school, money, family and social problems while also being a superhero, rather than simply functioning as an adult hero's sidekick.
Give me a concise explanation of the major live-action Spider-Man project in 2026.
As of August 28, 2026, Sony lists Spider-Man: Brand New Day as a 2026 film starring Tom Holland, directed by Destin Daniel Cretton.
Who directed Spider-Man: Brand New Day?
Spider-Man: Brand New Day is directed by Destin Daniel Cretton.
What is Spider-Man's core comic-book theme?
Responsibility is one of Spider-Man's defining themes: Peter's powers are repeatedly connected to the idea that having power creates an obligation to help others.
What is the next Spider-Verse movie listed after Across the Spider-Verse?
The Numbers franchise listing currently places Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse on June 17, 2027, but this should be treated as a current listing rather than an immutable fact.
Tell me about Harry Osborn.
Harry Osborn is Peter Parker's longtime friend and the son of Norman Osborn; his relationship with Peter becomes complicated by his father's identity as Green Goblin.
What is Marvel's Spider-Man (2018) game?
Marvel's Spider-Man is an action-adventure game developed by Insomniac Games and published by Sony Interactive Entertainment.
What are Spider-Man's web-shooters?
Peter Parker commonly uses web-shooters as technology for launching and manipulating web fluid.
What makes Spider-Man so agile?
Spider-Man has enhanced agility and reflexes that support his acrobatic fighting and movement.
Who are the creators of Spider-Man?
Spider-Man was created by writer Stan Lee and artist Steve Ditko. Marvel credits Lee as writer and Ditko as penciller on Amazing Fantasy #15.
How much did No Way Home make worldwide?
Spider-Man: No Way Home earned about $1.921 billion worldwide according to The Numbers.
Tell me about Electro.
Electro is a Spider-Man villain associated with electrical powers and, in the comics, with Max Dillon.
Tell me about in the cast of Spider-Man: Brand New Day.
The announced cast includes Tom Holland, Zendaya, Sadie Sink, Jacob Batalon, Jon Bernthal, Tramell Tillman, Michael Mando and Mark Ruffalo.
Tell me about Mysterio.
Mysterio is a master of illusion and deception, commonly associated with Quentin Beck.
Give me a concise explanation of Across the Spider-Verse about.
Across the Spider-Verse follows Miles Morales as he encounters a larger network of Spider-People across the multiverse.
